image_title: Effort and Utilization Metrics by Quarter
summary: The table presents quarterly metrics for effort and utilization from December 31, 2023, to December 31, 2024. It compares onsite and offshore effort percentages, as well as utilization rates including and excluding trainees. Notable trends include a slight increase in onsite effort over the period, while offshore effort shows a minor decline. Utilization rates, both including and excluding trainees, demonstrate a peak in September 2024, followed by a decrease by the end of 2024.
table_rows: Utilization: Including trainees: Dec 31 2024 = 83.4, Sep 30 2024 = 84.3, Dec 31 2023 = 81.7
Utilization: Excluding trainees: Dec 31 2024 = 86.0, Sep 30 2024 = 85.9, Dec 31 2023 = 82.7
